title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — Settling the Loss Above the Attachment Points
content:
An **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** claim is settled above the attachment points as follows.

**Dwelling.** The excess dwelling payable is the whole covered dwelling loss less the building attachment point less the tier's excess deductible, never below zero, capped at the excess dwelling limit.

**Personal property.** The excess personal property payable is the whole covered personal property loss less the contents attachment point, never below zero, capped at the excess personal property limit, and is zero when no excess personal property limit is written.

**Attachment points.** The attachment points are those fixed at binding, whatever the underlying actually paid.

**Payments and voids.** A new payment on a coverage is its payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage, issued only when positive, to the insured. What has already been paid is the sum of the payments issued on that claim number for that coverage less the sum voided on it, over the whole life of the claim. A void reverses one issued payment item in full by its reference and the amount is reissued under a new reference.

> Retired clause: loss of use is paid from the first dollar as incurred, up to the tier's loss-of-use limit and for no longer than the tier's maximum loss-of-use months after the date of loss.

This clause is **no longer in force** as written. It is superseded by the current basis: every loss-of-use payment is figured on the current loss-of-use payment basis, and the settlement sentences above on building and personal property payments are not affected.

## Dwelling payable, worked (hypothetical figures)

| Whole covered dwelling loss | Attachment point | Excess dwelling limit | Payable |
|---|---|---|---|
| 900000 | 250000 | 500000 | 500000 (650000 above the attachment, capped at the limit) |
| 600000 | 250000 | 500000 | 350000 |
| 240000 | 250000 | 500000 | 0 (never below zero) |

If 350000 is payable and 200000 has already been issued with 50000 of it voided, the new payment is 200000.

superseded_clauses: Loss of use is paid from the first dollar as incurred, up to loss_of_use_limit and for no longer than loss_of_use_max_months after the date of loss.
